title: prefill-sampler-and-quant-tiering-advisor
author: Diego Morales
release_notes: Adds a sampler-based prefill advisor and quantized-tier recommendation service to suggest cost-aware defaults for tenant warmups and batch shapes. Non-breaking; feature gated behind 'econ.prefill_advisor'.
description:
Context and motivation: Some tenants experience unexpectedly high token costs during cold-starts and microbursts because default prefill and batch shapes are generic. This PR introduces a lightweight sampling service (Prefill Sampler) that captures short-run traffic patterns and a Tiering Advisor that recommends quantization tiers and batch/caching defaults per-tenant. The goal is to automate conservative cost-optimization suggestions while preserving latency SLOs.

What this PR does (single contiguous description): Implements a Prefill Sampler that runs as a runtime-side sampling component: it records short histograms of sequence length, prefix reuse ratios, and cold-cache hit estimates (safely sampled at 0.1% by default). Adds a Tiering Advisor microservice that consumes sampler outputs and tenant-level telemetry (token-cost, latency P95, kv-cache hit rate) to recommend: quantization tier (none/8bit/4bit-int8), prefill batch shape (micro/small/standard), and cache durations for prefix caching. Introduces a new 'econ.prefill_advisor' feature flag and a TenantPrefillProfile CRD used only in Private/Dedicated deployments; hosted customers get recommendations surfaced in the Console but not persisted.

Checklist: - [x] Prefill Sampler runtime integration with request router - [x] Tiering Advisor API + basic rules engine - [x] Feature gate + config defaults - [x] Unit tests for sampler and advisor rules - [x] Integration test that simulates bursty traffic and asserts recommended profiles reduce projected token cost by >= 10% without increasing P95 > 5ms - [x] Telemetry: added sampling metrics and advisor decision event traces - [x] Docs snippets for Console UI and CLI dry-run

High-level commits summary: - Commit 1: initial sampler prototype and sampling API contract - Commit 2: add rules engine skeleton and simple heuristic rules (seq_len_based, prefix_reuse) - Commit 3: advisor gRPC API + HTTP translation layer for Console - Commit 4: feature flag wiring, config defaults, and CRD schema - Commit 5: unit & integration tests + mock telemetry generator - Commit 6: docs and examples for CLI --dry-run and Console preview - Commit 7: small followups addressing reviewer feedback (timeouts, metrics names)

Files touched (high level): - runtime/sampling/prefill_sampler.go: sampling logic and rate-limiter - runtime/sampling/prefill_sampler_test.go: unit tests - advisor/service/main.go: Tiering Advisor service entrypoint and rules engine - advisor/rules/basic_rules.go: simple heuristics used in this PR - advisor/api/proto/prefill.proto -> generated advisor/api/prefill.pb.go - api/tenant/crds/tenant_prefill_profile.yaml: CRD schema (Private/Dedicated only) - console/backend/econ_advisor_handler.go: HTTP proxy + preview endpoint - docs/guides/prefill_advisor.md: user guide and dry-run examples

Small illustrative diff snippets: - Added sampler config with conservative defaults (sampling_rate=0.001, max_buffer=512). - Rules: if median_seq_len < 32 and prefix_reuse > 0.6 -> recommend 'micro' batch shape; else if prefix_reuse > 0.85 and kv_cache_hit < 0.2 -> recommend longer cache durations.

Telemetry and CI expectations: CI initially had a flaky integration test (integration/prefill_burst_test) that timed out on first run in CI. I adjusted the test to use a mocked clock and reduced wall-clock dependencies; CI reran and all checks passed. The PR adds metrics: sampler.sampled_requests_total, sampler.buffer_overflows_total, advisor.recommendation_count, advisor.decision_duration_ms.

Review conversation (condensed): - Alyssa Chen (reviewer): "Nice separation between sampling and advising. A few nit comments: prefer context-based timeouts and clarify sampling rate config visibility to hosted users." - Diego (author): "Addressed timeouts; sampling rate now controlled by 'econ.prefill_sampling_rate' and defaults are lower for hosted tier." - Priya Nair (reviewer): "Concern about privacy: are we logging any PII?" - Diego: "No PII. Sampler records only aggregate stats and hashed tenant ids; added a note in telemetry policy docs." - Tomás Rivera: "Can we gate the CRD creation behind an installer flag?" - Diego: "Yes—CRD manifests are emitted only when 'private.enable_prefill_profiles' is true in installer values. Added to helm chart docs." - Alyssa: "Integration test still relied on real scheduler; switched to mocked scheduler. LGTM after green CI."

CI checks: - unit-tests: pass - linters: pass (golangci-lint) - integration-tests: pass (after rerun) - e2e: pass (smoke) - security-scan: pass

Backward compatibility and safety: The Tiering Advisor only produces recommendations; no automatic changes are applied to runtime unless tenant opts in or an admin applies recommendations. Defaults remain unchanged. Feature is disabled by default for hosted customers and enabled behind feature flag for private/dedicated tenants where an admin explicitly opts in.

Operational notes: - Advisor exposes a /preview endpoint that returns a sample recommended profile and projected 30-day cost delta. - Recommendations include a confidence score (low/medium/high). Low-confidence suggestions require manual review. - Added alert econ.advisor.sync_failures > 3 in 5m to platform SRE runbook.

Migration plan: No data migrations required. For Private installs that opt-in, CRD creation is performed during installer run. For Hosted customers, Console surfaces suggestions in a non-intrusive banner and a Console 'Recommendations' tab under the tenant page.

Performance validation: Load test setup used tenant traffic generator with bursty Poisson bursts; advisor recommendations produced projected token cost improvements between 12-28% in tests while keeping P95 within 3ms of baseline most frequently.

Follow-ups planned: - Add a machine-learned decision model (offline) to complement heuristic rules - Expose batch-shape tuning CLI for operators - Add automatic A/B rollout (opt-in) for high-confidence recommendations

Merge method and outcome: Squash and merge after two approving reviews and green CI. Merge commit message includes Linear links (ENG-1842, ENG-1909) and a concise summary of the feature.

notes_for_release: Feature gated; recommended to operators. Console will show recommendations for hosted read-only preview; Private/Dedicated admins can opt-in to apply profiles. Rollout staged: internal beta -> 10 tenants -> broad opt-in.
safety_and_privacy: Sampler only collects aggregate counters and hashed tenant IDs. No raw prompts or PII are logged. Telemetry policy updated and privacy review completed.
changelog_entry: Add Prefill Sampler and Tiering Advisor: opt-in cost-optimization recommendations for prefill/batch/cache and quantization tiering.
testing_summary: Unit coverage added for sampler rules; integration simulates multi-burst traffic pattern; CI shows consistent timeouts fixed by test refactor; load tests demonstrate 12-28% projected cost improvement in simulated workloads.
